title: Instant Remediate Plugin + Safety Probes for Support Shortcuts
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a lightweight Instant Remediate Plugin and accompanying Safety Probes that expose common on-call remediations as safe, idempotent commands in the operator UI and CLI. The plugin converts curated runbook steps into single-click (or single-command) actions with preflight checks, automatic rollbacks, audit logging, and rate/permission gating. Goals: reduce MTTR for common incidents by 30%, provide deterministic telemetry to validate remediations, and ensure zero-blast safety via probes and staged execution. Scope includes: action schema design, probe hooks (health checks/feature flags/traffic quiesce), RBAC integration with existing SSO rules, audit event format for the console and external SIEM, and a small local agent shim for on-prem Private customers. Out of scope: full runbook language conversion and long-running multi-step orchestrations (those remain in runflow). Constraints: must be compatible with Dedicated nodes (no external network egress for private deployments), must work with current token model and auditing system, and should not add more than 2% p99 latency to existing operator flows when idle. Deliverables: 1) plugin service and UI affordance, 2) probe library for common checks, 3) migration tool to map 20 highest-frequency runbook steps to shortcut actions, 4) integration tests and canary plan for staged rollout.
comments: 2025-02-21: Kickoff w/ SRE and Support. Collected top 24 manual remediations from last 6 months (pagerduty/export). Prioritized 12 for MVP based on frequency + blast radius.

2025-02-25: Architecture spike completed. Decided on a two-process model: controller-service (hosted/private) + ephemeral agent (for on-prem, optional). Tradeoffs: agent increases install surface but avoids egress for air-gapped customers.

2025-03-01: Design review with Product & Security. Security requested preflight probes be pluggable and require explicit approver for high-risk actions. Added strict audit schema and token-scoped temporary credentials for action execution.

2025-03-03: Prototype CLI shim passes integration tests against staging runtime. Found race in KV cache invalidation when action mutates model-serving config; added optimistic locking and probe-based cooldown.

2025-03-05: Opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops-shortcuts/pull/214 (controller + probe library). Requesting code review from @lucas and @amedina. Planning canary rollout to internal infra next week.

2025-03-06: Telemetry hooks defined. Instrumentation will emit action.start/action.end/action.rollback with context labels: actor, target_pool, model_version, probe_results. Dashboard draft: https://grafana.redwood-infra/d/ops-shortcuts/remediation-metrics.
Blocked: waiting on RBAC tokens endpoint changes (ENG-672401) for scoped temporary credentials — coordinating with infra team.
Follow-up: map remaining 8 remediation steps to templated actions as part of next cycle. Consider a 'dry-run' toggle for low-risk actions so support can validate without side-effects.
